requirements: latest round passed verifier without side effects
all approved command strings covered with successful non-timed-out exits
saved positive independent review of same fingerprint and round
run status running and control run, item phase accept
acceptance_gate.stale: changed checkout during/after review, wrong round, missing/failed/stale verifier or outstanding findings refuses acceptance

automation.approval: explicit launch-codex --auto --plan approves the bounded supplied plan; model output never widens scope, criteria, commands or permissions

codex.cancellation: timeout/control cancellation terminates process group, SIGTERM then SIGKILL after 3 seconds
codex.input: JSON context on stdin; optional --model; no shell
codex.privacy: private schema/result/log in run directory; modes 0600 and directory 0700
codex.review_validation: accept requires no findings; request_changes requires concrete findings; known exact keys, nonempty strings and bounded findings list; prepare task at most 60000 characters
codex.trust: repository files, executor reports and tool output are untrusted evidence; model response never authorizes widening approved plan

completion.apply: completed only after final fingerprint check and durable delivered marker from existing crash-safe materializer under admission lock
completion.manual: ready after accepted final integration result; no main apply
completion.safety: no automatic commit/push/deploy; main HEAD/index unchanged; delivery crash may leave partial writes and requires safe resume, never automatic rollback

inheritance.baseline: new execution baseline captured after inheritance; delivery remains cumulative relative to original main snapshot
gates: created bound checkout with same repository identity
parent fingerprint unchanged before and after materialization
artifact owner/base/entries equal accepted cumulative result
target state and symlink ancestor checks
inheritance.scope: task artifact scope accumulates accepted steps; verifier/acceptance separately enforce only current approved step scope

internal_mcp.acceptance: public accept also enforces managed run/control/review gate under lifecycle lock
internal_mcp.managed_revision: another caller gets automation_managed; internal coordinator supplies matching automation_run_id
internal_mcp.submit_provenance: automation_parent, automation_parent_fingerprint and automation_run_id pinned into hash/snapshot; parent must be accepted worktree task in same workflow

plan.codex_model: optional nonempty string, at most 200 characters
plan.dependency_order: stable topological order; unknown/duplicate/self dependencies or cycles reject plan
plan.scope: relative authorized paths, no absolute scopes; nonempty safe step and final verifier commands; configured known profiles only

proof_boundary.not_proven: full automatic workflow with both real models on a user project; source tests were not run by manifest AST verification
proof_boundary.reported_live: source docs report read-only Codex prepare and OpenCode worktree smoke separately

recovery.boot: detached supervisor survives terminal exit; after process/reboot crash resume is explicit, no built-in boot autostart
recovery.config_main_drift: bound config hash or original main fingerprint change blocks further steps
recovery.control: pause saves phase and stops coordinator; explicit resume clears blocker and preserves progress; stop closes unfinished tasks cooperatively, including paused/blocked/crashed coordinator
recovery.intents: persist submit/revision request ids before operation; replay existing request after crash instead of resending; accept repeat is idempotent then cumulative artifact rebuilt before advancing
recovery.limits: elapsed time across resumes, per-step revisions and bounded Codex timeout/retries; failures persist a blocker

run.final_step: __final__ integration task appended with union scopes and approved final_test_commands
run.load_validation: exact schema17 and canonical UUID matching document.run_id; status/control authoritative from row; Python loader does not fully revalidate every persisted plan/phase field
run.one_unfinished: unique expression index per project database includes paused and blocked

diff_stat.counts: one non-negative integer per change kind, each 0..1000000
diff_stat.counts_bound: counts are the exact totals for the round while entries may be truncated
diff_stat.entries: at most 200 detail entries; each is {path, change, kind} and, when change=renamed, also from

checkpoint.encoding: compact JSON text written with sort_keys=True; parse_round_checkpoint accepts a JSON string or an already-decoded dict
checkpoint.evidence: storage.py:ROUND_CHECKPOINT_* / storage.py:parse_round_checkpoint / git_snapshot.py:CHECKPOINT_VERSION / git_snapshot.py:worktree_state / git_snapshot.py:diff_round_stat / worker.py:_build_round_checkpoint / worker.py:_previous_checkpoint_repos

malformed_handling.malformed: parse_round_checkpoint returns None for a non-dict payload, empty/invalid JSON, an unknown version, repositories that are not a 1..64 list, a non-canonical 'workspace'+'external N' label topology, a non-bool available, a missing/unbounded diff_stat, and for an available repository missing any of head/index_fingerprint/worktree_fingerprint/changed/absent or exceeding a bound, or a workspace fingerprint-mirror mismatch; the whole value is then unavailable and is never echoed or reused as a predecessor
malformed_handling.normalization: the parser reads only known keys, so unknown top-level or per-field keys are dropped, not rejected. For an available=false repository it requires only label, available and a well-formed bounded diff_stat: it does not reject extra/legacy state keys and does not enforce the canonical empty diff_stat the writer emits, nor verify truncated equals the computed totals. The top-level workspace mirror accepts an absent or explicit-null head/index_fingerprint/worktree_fingerprint when the workspace is unavailable, whereas the writer always emits all three as JSON null
malformed_handling.unavailable: checkpoint_json null or parse_round_checkpoint returning None means the round has no checkpoint and cannot be a predecessor; the worker persists null for that round
malformed_handling.unknown_version: a version other than the accepted value is rejected with None

predecessor.no_backward_fallback: a missing, corrupt, unknown-version or oversized immediately-preceding (round N-1) checkpoint raises _CheckpointUnavailable; the current checkpoint is persisted as unavailable and the worker never scans further back to an older checkpoint or the submit-time baseline
predecessor.rule: the delta of round N is computed against round N-1's valid checkpoint only; round 1 is measured against the submit-time (direct) or clean-checkout (worktree) baseline
predecessor.topology: the predecessor must describe the exact same canonical repository topology in the same order and every predecessor repository must be available, otherwise the current checkpoint is unavailable fail-closed

checkpoint.privacy: only repository-relative paths, bounded numeric counts and content-free fingerprints are persisted; file content, absolute external-repository roots, credentials, session ids and task text are never stored or rendered

repository.fingerprints: head, index_fingerprint and worktree_fingerprint are bounded hex refs of at most 128 characters
repository.label: canonical writer labels only: 'workspace' plus contiguous unique 'external N' with 1 <= N <= 64; a duplicate, reordered or missing label rejects the whole checkpoint
repository.label_taxonomy: the first repository is always 'workspace'; external repositories are numbered from 1 in sorted canonical root order
repository.unavailable: writer shape: available=false carries only label, available and the canonical empty diff_stat, with no head/index/state keys; the parser is more lenient and ignores any extra keys (see malformed_handling.normalization)
repository.unavailable_reason: the repository root is missing or is not a usable Git work tree, or its state could not be read

state.absent: sorted repository-relative paths present in the baseline but absent in this round; at most 2000 entries
state.changed: repository-relative path -> {digest (bounded hex), kind}; at most 2000 keys
state.combined_bound: len(changed) + len(absent) must not exceed 2000 per repository; the exact state is reused verbatim as the next round's predecessor and is never truncated, so exceeding the bound makes the whole checkpoint unavailable

top_level.workspace_fingerprint_mirror: head, index_fingerprint and worktree_fingerprint mirror the workspace repository exactly: present and equal when it is available, and all null when it is not; a partial or mismatched mirror rejects the whole checkpoint

unavailable_conditions: the whole checkpoint is null when len(changed)+len(absent) exceeds 2000 for any repository (the exact predecessor state cannot be preserved verbatim)
the whole checkpoint is null when a predecessor repository is unavailable or the repository label topology differs
the whole checkpoint is null when the immediately preceding round has no valid checkpoint (missing, corrupt, unknown-version or oversized)
the whole checkpoint is null when an outer failure escapes collection or normalization, including _CheckpointUnavailable and any unexpected exception

a single repository whose root is missing, is not a usable Git work tree or raises GitError/OSError is NOT a whole-checkpoint failure: it is emitted as available=false with the writer's canonical empty diff_stat and empty state, and collection continues for the other repositories

exit_codes.0: success; start/stop ok; doctor/status ready; add-project dry-run or a clean --apply; deliver-task ok; smoke-opencode passed; worker completed or refused no-op
exit_codes.1: doctor/status not ready; add-project --apply offline checks failed; deliver-task refused (active_writers or a DeliveryError); mcp/serve-mcp lock busy; smoke-opencode runtime_regression
exit_codes.2: user-facing error (ConfigError, CredentialError, BridgeError, ProjectEnvError) or argparse usage error; prune/quarantine selection errors and any per-candidate quarantine failure; worker unknown task/round; smoke-opencode openapi_incompatible

rules: allow_parallel_writers must be a boolean; false is the default and true is accepted only when execution_mode is 'worktree'
auto_approve_external_directories entries must be existing absolute directories, canonicalized with resolve(strict=True), and '/' is rejected
auto_approve_permissions must not contain 'external_directory'; that permission is controlled by explicit external roots and the opt-in auto_approve_state_directory flag
auto_approve_state_directory defaults to false and must be a real boolean; true rejects state_root '/' or a root containing '*' or '?'
default_profile must be a non-empty string without surrounding whitespace and must name a builtin or custom profile
delivery_mode defaults to 'manual'; exact 'manual' or 'on_accept' only, no whitespace or non-string values; on_accept requires execution_mode='worktree'
execution_mode is optional and defaults to 'direct'; the only accepted values are exactly 'direct' and 'worktree' (no normalization, no surrounding whitespace)
max_active_tasks is optional and defaults to 1; it must be a positive integer (booleans, zero, negatives and non-integers are rejected)
max_rounds must be a positive integer
mcp_token_file must be a separate credential file from password_file and unique across projects
mcp_url and mcp_token_file must be set together; mcp_url must end with /mcp on 127.0.0.1 with an explicit port
opencode_model must be '<providerID>/<modelID>', split on the first '/' only
opencode_url must be http://127.0.0.1:<port> with an explicit port in 1..65535 and no path, query, fragment, username or password
profiles is an optional [projects.<id>.profiles.<profile_id>] table; each entry must be a table, requires 'purpose' and accepts 'instructions' and 'model'; unknown keys are rejected
state directory access is a permission-only grant; state_root is not added to trusted external Git roots or linked-project routing
workspace must be an existing directory; relative paths resolve against the config file directory
workspaces, server endpoints and credential files must be unique across projects

rust_storage.note: manifest refresh does not migrate Rust state or widen schema guards; Python runtime state/history are never imported

limitations: dry-run performs the full preflight with zero writes
--build writes only the private artifact; --apply requires an accepted task and a created worktree row
an interrupted --apply may leave a partially materialized base/artifact mix; resume accepts a path only in exact base or exact artifact state and otherwise reports needs_manual_recovery
there is no automatic rollback; --apply never mutates Git HEAD, refs or the index and post-verifies them unchanged
deliver-task remains an explicit CLI, never an MCP tool; opt-in on_accept and approved automatic plans reuse its materializer; it refuses while any writer reservation or writer-status task remains

task_policy.distinction: CLI operation modes dry-run/build/apply and automatic plan delivery apply/manual are separate contracts
task_policy.frozen: effective policy copied from config at submit; live config changes never alter an existing task
task_policy.helper_locks: caller must hold project lifecycle and admission locks; helper never reacquires them
task_policy.on_accept_helper: run_auto_delivery: none builds missing artifact then applies; applying resumes existing journal without rebuild; delivered returns without reapply

project_entry.ready: true only when every selected server kind is ready; errors are isolated per project and never hide the other projects

servers.rule: ready is endpoint readiness (mcp: mcp_url configured plus a bounded SDK probe; opencode: bounded probe) and is independent of the ownership record. The record is inspected read-only and never deleted or rewritten: managed=true only for a live record bound to this project, while a stale or missing record reports managed=false yet can still be ready=true. Only an invalid or binding-mismatched record additionally forces ready=false (tests/test_runtime.py:test_status_all_json_never_touches_stale_process_record asserts stale + ready=true + exit 0)

diagnostics.read_only: never initializes storage, never creates a state directory/database/WAL or runtime.lock, never migrates the schema, never runs worker/task recovery and never writes runtime or database state. Probes are read-only and bounded by short timeouts: the MCP readiness probe initializes the SDK streamable-HTTP client, lists the tools and requires exactly the six public tools, then calls project_info and checks project_id/workspace/endpoint; the OpenCode readiness probe calls /path (root directory), health and the OpenAPI document; collect_project_snapshot additionally probes OpenCode server/session health when probe_opencode is enabled. A failed or unresponsive probe degrades to not-ready/reachable=false instead of retrying or writing; every database read uses mode=ro with a short busy timeout

snapshot.notes: collect_project_snapshot never raises: error is null or a short reason collected from the read-only query, and non-database fields are still reported. active_task copies persisted task_id, status, created_at and updated_at verbatim; only round_number and revision_count are validated as integers, age_seconds/last_round_duration_seconds degrade to null on unparseable timestamps, and a profile/profile_source label is emitted only for a safe matching profile id backed by a non-historical snapshot (any other value is dropped). active_writers is every persisted active_writers ledger row for the project selected with no LIMIT, each reported as the raw persisted {task_id, status} (status may be null when the task row is absent); unlike the Codex hook there is no hook-style validation and no fixed output bound, so corrupt persisted strings are surfaced as-is rather than sanitized.

worktree_summary.error: str(exc)[:200], returned alongside present=false (not instead of it) when the read-only query fails; not guaranteed path-free for every exception
worktree_summary.present: false when there is no active or accepted worktree-mode task
worktree_summary.server_note: 'server stopped at accept' for an accepted worktree task
worktree_summary.server_state: read-only process-record state, defaulting to 'unknown' when the record cannot be read

direct.dirty_policy: an in-scope dirty baseline is allowed only when this task's own persisted submit-time allow_dirty is true; a dirty baseline with allow_dirty=false blocks with baseline_dirty. No policy is inherited from dependencies or from any other project.
direct.legacy_task: a direct task without a persisted manifest keeps its historical empty baseline and is neither rebaselined nor blocked
direct.outside_scope: any pre-existing dirty path outside the task's allowed_paths blocks with baseline_dirty_outside_scope regardless of allow_dirty
direct.rebaseline: storage.refresh_task_baseline persists a fresh snapshot (current HEAD/index/manifest plus refreshed external-repository snapshots) before the atomic activation
direct.unavailable: a workspace that is not a Git repo or cannot be snapshotted blocks with baseline_unavailable

worktree.blocker: no baseline blocker is produced by activation
worktree.rebaseline: worker derives execution baseline from persisted base_head in task checkout; approved automation may seed validated accepted predecessor artifact before taking the new execution baseline

gates: the call is an explicit task_status activation (allow_waiting_activation); startup recovery never sets it; an approved automatic coordinator calls task_status explicitly
admission.lock is held for the short activation critical section
dependency_gate state == ready (every depends_on resolves to an accepted task in the same workflow and a linked project)
single-writer mode: worker.lock is free; parallel mode: the atomic storage admission re-checks scope overlap instead
storage.activate_waiting_dependencies is a conditional atomic update; exactly one caller wins and the loser does not spawn
activation.note: activation remains an explicit task_status action; approved coordinator may invoke it, ordinary startup recovery never activates waiting tasks
activation.trigger: an explicit task_status call, gated by dependencies and admission; the required execution baseline depends on execution_mode and the task's own persisted policy (direct), or is derived from the persisted base_head (worktree)

needs_user_recovery.background: review/background recovery keeps blocker gate; explicit needs_user recovery requires usable bound endpoint and re-observes history, never approves permissions or answers questions
needs_user_recovery.claim: one conditional needs_user task update wins; task becomes implementing/revising according to round kind; parked needs_user round becomes observing, undelivered pending round remains pending; close request refuses claim
needs_user_recovery.explicit_zero_wait: wait_seconds=0 still attempts one needs_user recovery and returns actual persisted status, without waiting for completion; zero-wait never reopens failed tasks
needs_user_recovery.lease: worker_started_at stamped before spawn; 10-second startup grace prevents spawn-before-lock duplicates; mark_worker_started overwrites it; exact matching lease required for failed-spawn rollback
needs_user_recovery.loser: losing/repeated caller rereads task before returning; no duplicate prompt, round or revision_count change
needs_user_recovery.probes: task/project worker lock probes serialized inside process to avoid false busy from simultaneous probes; real cross-process holders remain detected

recoverable_failure.rule: only an OpenCode assistant error on the current round is recoverable; all infrastructure/invariant failures stay terminal
recoverable_failure.scope: task.status=failed, current round.status=failed, round.error_code=assistant_error, task.close_requested_at is null

prompt not found in session history after the delivery grace
workspace_mismatch, session_not_found, session_directory_mismatch, assistant_error or worker_error

explicit task_status activation after every dependency is accepted; always implementing, never revising

worker_error_codes.session_directory_mismatch: resolved session directory differs from the workspace
worker_error_codes.transient_error: OpenCode unavailable for the whole session-check window

contract.AGENT_BRIDGE_MCP_TOKEN_<PROJECT_ID_UPPER: bearer token for a linked HTTP MCP server

hook.fail_open: any read, config, database or other failure prints nothing, writes nothing to stderr and exits 0, so the user's prompt is never blocked
hook.idle: no active task prints nothing and exits 0
hook.multiple_active_tasks: with more than one active writer each task is listed by safe identity/status only and Codex is told to call task_status with an explicit task_id (a bare task_status returns ambiguous_task); the hook never selects an arbitrary task
hook.privacy: never emits task text, result, findings, credentials, session id, private/absolute paths or commands; only project id, task id, status, updated_at, an optional safe phase (agent/verifying) and a fixed status-dependent instruction
hook.read_only: never writes SQLite, never starts a worker or recovery, never reaches OpenCode/MCP/network and never calls a lifecycle MCP tool (submit_task/accept_task/request_changes/close_task)

safe_brief.source: storage.read_active_task_briefs (read-only connection with a bounded busy timeout)
safe_brief.validation: every field is checked by is_safe_active_task_brief before emission; any invalid field raises ValueError and the caller fails open with no output instead of emitting sanitized or truncated text

accept_delivery.admission_fence: taken before server stop and accepted transition releases own reservation, held across build/apply; other writer reservations/tasks still block delivery
accept_delivery.crash: deliberate process termination and SimulationCrash are not caught as ordinary refusal
accept_delivery.diagnostics: OSError errno/strerror, path-like fragments redacted, whitespace collapsed, message bounded to 240 chars; filename surfaced only if safely project-workspace relative
accept_delivery.event: delivery_refused is best-effort and never masks the original failure
accept_delivery.failure: after accepted transition a DeliveryError/OSError/sqlite3.Error becomes accepted + structured refusal with real persisted delivery_state, or unknown when state is unreadable; artifact/journal/checkout survive; no rollback
accept_delivery.first_busy: awaiting_review with error admission_lock_busy; server is not stopped and no accepted transition occurs
accept_delivery.repeat: manual/direct accepts and already-delivered on_accept return immediately; accepted undelivered on_accept acquires lifecycle/admission and retries/resumes

budget.note: warning does not gate; allow_budget_override bypasses only the budget gate, never secret/allowed_paths/git/max_rounds gates

internal_only.note: internal helpers and flags are not public tool arguments
internal_only.request_changes_impl_argument_order: allow_suspected_secrets precedes structured_findings internally; the public wrapper reorders

structured_findings.validation: path must resolve inside the task allowed_paths; None preserves text-only historical behavior

notes: verbose=true maps to the full historical contract; verbose=false maps to the minimal/compact view
phase is 'verifying' while a verifier is running, otherwise 'agent'
verification_progress is present only while a verifier is running and never contains command text or log paths
the minimal awaiting_review budget block is trimmed to configured/warning/exhausted/exhausted_fields/gate/gate_reason
workflow_gate is surfaced only for waiting_dependencies
worktree status includes the frozen task delivery_mode and actual delivery_state; accepted on_accept tasks include a read-only delivery summary
summary states: pending/refused/applying/delivered; applying takes precedence over an older refusal; last_attempt surfaces the most recent delivery_refused event

tools.summary: Return the immutable project binding, safe active writer set, profile metadata and active task state.

tools.name: request_changes
tools.summary: Send review findings for an awaiting_review task. Idempotent by request_id. Budget exhaustion and corruption gate the new revision round unless allow_budget_override is set.

tools.name: submit_task
tools.summary: Create a task and start implementation. Idempotent by request_id. A task whose dependencies are not yet accepted starts as waiting_dependencies.

tools.name: task_status
tools.summary: Return status of a task. wait_seconds is bounded to 0..300. Without task_id an empty active set is no_active_task and more than one active task is ambiguous_task. verbose=true returns the full contract; the default is minimal/compact.

http.auth: Bearer token compared with secrets.compare_digest against mcp_token_file

profiles.definition_hash: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of {id, purpose, instructions, model}

entry_points.command: agent-bridge serve-opencode-worktree --project ID --config PATH --state-root PATH --task TASK_ID --port N
entry_points.name: opencode_worktree_server

entry_points.command: agent-bridge worker --project ID --config PATH --state-root PATH --task TASK_ID --round N
entry_points.name: worker

limitations: worktree startup serialized by runtime.lock with bounded 60-second wait; ordinary start/status/stop keep immediate failure; staggered parallel smoke proves concurrent execution, not simultaneous spawn
approved opt-in plans have detached sequential execution and review/accept; no boot-time autostart, arbitrary global scheduler, automatic merge/commit/push/deploy or A2A adapter

locks.scope: one MCP server process per project
one worker process per project in single-writer mode; also serializes accept/close/recovery, prune/quarantine cleanup and deliver-task
one worker/lifecycle section per task (used in both single and parallel modes)
one start/stop/status operation and one worktree server startup across all projects sharing a state root

locks.mechanism: fcntl.flock LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB with optional bounded wait
locks.scope: one approved coordinator per project; run holds lock throughout coordinator lifetime, launcher writes process lease before child acquires lock

manager_lock_wait.deadline: monotonic; roots acquired all-or-nothing in sorted canonical order; all fds closed on release/error/timeout/interrupt
manager_lock_wait.timeout: before worktree server spawn, port reservation or process record

automation.launch_lease: record with pid/start/binding written before child obtains automation.lock; repeated launch/resume refuses live or starting coordinator

process_records.validation: pid must be an int > 1, start must be a string, and /proc start ticks must match the live process

not_frozen: internal python module layout and class/function names
opencode message/part JSON internals beyond documented fields
sqlite physical column order and internal index names beyond documented uniqueness
task_id, session_id, message_id and timestamp values
verification output bytes and full log file contents
worker polling/timeout tuning defaults and AB_* environment overrides

security.allow_suspected_secrets: boolean override on submit_task and request_changes; false by default

error.note: never returns the matched value or position

state_directory_approval.matcher_boundary: no wildcard escaping is assumed; narrowly scoped pattern is required, not a universal allow rule
state_directory_approval.worker: existing literal/glob/symlink/traversal confinement against external roots plus opt-in state_root; external Git roots and linked-project mapping unchanged

indexes.name: ix_tasks_project_status
indexes.purpose: nonunique task lookup per project and status

indexes.name: ux_active_writers_single
indexes.purpose: at most one active writer reservation per project while parallel=0

indexes.definition: UNIQUE automation_runs((1)) WHERE status NOT IN ('completed','ready','stopped')
indexes.name: ux_automation_unfinished
indexes.purpose: one unfinished run per database including paused and blocked runs

invariants: PRAGMA user_version is only changed by a migration; versions outside 0..17 are refused
fresh v17 has no UNIQUE tasks(project_id) index (ux_tasks_active); single-writer enforcement is the partial unique ux_active_writers_single plus atomic admission
admission counts both the reservation ledger and real persisted writer-status task rows inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE
parallel writers require canonically scope-disjoint allowed_paths; overlap raises ScopeOverlap and corrupt scope data fails closed
admission bound: count_unfinished_tasks() (including waiting_dependencies) must stay below max_active_tasks
waiting_dependencies never holds an active writer reservation
a reservation is released only when a task reaches accepted/closed (or prune), never merely because a worker exited
waiting_dependencies -> implementing activation is a conditional atomic UPDATE; exactly one caller wins
round completion and task status update are atomic in one transaction (finish_round)
rounds(project_id, request_id) is unique for request idempotency
each round references an existing task (foreign key rounds.task_id -> tasks.task_id)
task.allowed_paths, task.test_commands, task.depends_on, task.snapshot and task.budget_json, round.result_json, round.verifier_json, round.structured_findings and round.checkpoint_json are JSON text
tasks.session_id points at the current round's session and is NULL between revision-round creation and session resolution
profile/profile_json/profile_hash/profile_source persist an immutable profile snapshot; profile_hash is the canonical snapshot hash
verifier_state is 'running' or 'done'; a 'done' result is never overwritten and is reused by recovery
worktree status transitions are fail-closed
reconcile_active_writers is idempotent: it drops orphan/terminal reservations and backfills reservations for persisted writer-status tasks
tasks.delivery_mode is frozen at creation; absent/unknown/corrupt persisted values normalize to manual and never enable automatic delivery
automation_runs.document persists run identity, approved plan, binding, phases, intents and review evidence; run status/control are authoritative columns
automation_run terminal status is completed/ready/stopped; paused and blocked runs retain the unique unfinished slot

needs_user recovery claim stamps task/round/worker_started_at spawn lease/event atomically, reuses the round and never changes revision_count or outbound message; failed spawn release requires the exact unchanged lease

changes: tasks.execution_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'direct' added
waiting_dependencies joined the intermediate partial unique ux_tasks_active (historical, removed at v15)
_reconcile_active_writers_in_conn backfills reservations for persisted writer-status tasks
active_writers.parallel INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 added
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_active_writers_single ON active_writers(project_id) WHERE parallel=0
CREATE INDEX ix_tasks_project_status ON tasks(project_id, status)
tasks.delivery_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual' added; existing tasks keep manual delivery
automation_runs table added with control TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'run'
unique expression index ux_automation_unfinished added; completed/ready/stopped excluded, paused/blocked still occupy the slot

active_writers.note: logical reservation ledger; intentionally not foreign-key bound so reconcile can backfill/drop rows

automation_runs.note: document is JSON text; one unfinished automatic run per project database, independent of task ids

storage.unsupported_version_behavior: refuse to modify and raise StorageError

limitations: external directories, submodules, Git LFS, sparse checkout and nested repositories are not supported and fail closed
environment/dependency setup is not performed; agreed test_commands must supply their own environment
task-scoped startup waits at most 60 seconds for shared runtime.lock; startup remains serialized, model rendezvous proves concurrent execution
ordinary startup never auto-activates waiting tasks; an approved coordinator explicitly invokes task_status and blocks on unresolved user actions
